description: This file defines a PHP mock class 'EmailMock' that extends the 'Email' class, used for unit testing email-related functionalities within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for setting error states and preparing SMTP info, tailored for testing contexts.

classes.name: EmailMock
classes.description: A mock class for the Email class used in testing, providing methods to manipulate email error states and SMTP info setup.

methods.name: setLastSaveAndStoreInSentErrorPublic
methods.description: Sets the last save and store error state, exposing the internal error handling method for testing purposes.

methods.name: setMailer
